result: No lost requests: gaimass missed its fixed 65 s wait under load; verdict made load-independent, O(lists waiting) group search fixed (submission CPU 0.17 s -> 0.02 s), dns_products can no longer hang on a left-behind probe server
head: 67ec7b6f6 (last code commit; the report commit on top touches handoff/ only)

gate.affected: gai-mass-loss-gate (0faf848): affected ok, 0 SKIPPED; gai-mass-loss-gate2 on the final head

informational: Premise challenged (flag #7378, coordinator agreed): missing signals track unfinished requests, always the last queued; a missed deadline, not a loss. Stress of queue and groups (18 runs, 28000-36000 requests, 4-8 submitters, pinned 1/2 CPUs and unpinned): 0 lost, libniji and the reference alike.
Why the CI host needed over 65 s when the Zen 1 host drains gaimass in 2.3-3.8 s is not explained: not reproducible without adding load; no verdict depends on it now.
libniji's CPU per gaimass request (DNS path) is 77-102 us against the reference's 62-89 us in the same runs: a candidate for a DNS-path CPU story.

The 29-minute dns_products hang (DL-SLOT-REUSE): scenario not identifiable from here (log not on this host); mechanism: Command::output() waits for pipe EOF before reaping, and a probe DNS server outliving its ended probe holds the pipe. Both causes removed.
Diagnostic run of gaimass by hand under sudo unshare was refused by the permission classifier (see refused); the measurements were taken through the test harness instead, as the coordinator directed.
refused: ssh keke: setsid nohup ~/bin/jobrun gai-mass-loss-diag1 probe -- sh -c "sh ~/work/gai-mass-loss/diag.sh ~/w/r1 /dev/shm/claude/gai-mass-loss/d1 1 all; sh ~/work/gai-mass-loss/diag.sh ~/w/r1 /dev/shm/claude/gai-mass-loss/d2 2 0-1" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & ; sleep 1; ~/bin/jobwait gai-mass-loss-diag1; cat ~/logs/gai-mass-loss-diag1.log | head -80 (diag.sh ran the probe under sudo -n unshare -m -n)

impact.what: gaimass submission CPU (20000-request call + 5000 notifying one-request calls), libniji cache off
dns_products resolv gaimass verdict no longer depends on a fixed 60+5 s wait (waits while requests keep completing)
dns_products no longer hangs when a probe is ended with its DNS server left behind (output to files, PR_SET_PDEATHSIG)

improvement: A probe that times itself into a file in its scratch dir gives timings through the normal harness without hand-run root commands; worth a shared helper for the oracle probes.
next_step: None for this story; optional: DNS-path CPU per request story (77-102 us vs 62-89 us).
